sections.skill: Grow through local outreach, referrals and networking

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: What is a referral?

choices.text: A tax form sent to the state
A discount the owner gives only to herself
A paid ad on a billboard
A recommendation from a happy customer

questions.correct_answer: A recommendation from a happy customer
questions.intro: Local businesses often grow through people. LOCAL OUTREACH means showing up where customers are: farmers markets, community events, partnerships with nearby businesses. REFERRALS are recommendations from happy customers; you can ask for them directly and make it easy ("Tell a friend; you both get 10 percent off"). NETWORKING means building real relationships with people who serve the same customers, like a wedding photographer and a florist. Follow up, keep promises, and give before you ask.

sections.skill: A good restaurant tip from a friend

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: A friend recommending Luca's is like what?
questions.correct_answer: A referral
questions.intro: If a friend says, "Try the pasta at Luca's, it's great," you are more likely to go than if you saw an ad. That is a referral. Now imagine Luca's gives your friend and you a free dessert for the recommendation: that is a referral reward. And if Luca's chef is friends with the wine shop next door, they send customers to each other: that is networking.
